## dc2c4869445c

**Classification: Domain question / suspected shortcut.** Generator SHA-256 `a032e303d8d7f2758cae156c2c31a5c65d833021be7c33e414faaa0adfd414b1`; declared rule hash `f9fbf72b057d`.

The authority clips reflected cells individually at grid boundaries, but generation and `self_check` forbid any seed whose reflected block would clip. Therefore a plausible all-or-nothing rival—skip the entire reflected copy whenever any target cell is out of bounds—agrees on the whole generated/accepted domain even though it is not the reference rule.

The 12×12 witness at `checks/audit/dc2c4869445c/input.json` is reference-lawful but intentionally outside `self_check`, which reports `reflection block clips the grid edge`. The Racket output at `checks/audit/dc2c4869445c/racket.json` keeps the in-bounds portion, while `checks/audit/dc2c4869445c/rival_all_or_nothing.json` leaves the input unchanged. `metadata.json` records the command and classification.

This is not asserted as an in-domain label defect. The domain probe generated 100/100 clean examples in each difficulty and accepted all 8 canonical inputs; all exclude clipping and hence cannot distinguish the two rules. Evidence: `checks/audit/dc2c4869445c/domain_probe.json`. The focused lint and self-check probes were green; the separately started override probe was interrupted and is not claimed as a result.
